components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary thumb-friendly action button for saving forms or starting quick capture.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--color-brand, #28543e); color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: opacity 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #28543e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-emphasis secondary or cancel action paired alongside primary buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(38,60,50,0.2); border-radius: 1rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #263c32); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(38,60,50,0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #263c32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: Standard <x-card> container for dashboard widgets, agenda lists, and module panels.
components.html:
Hari Ini & Besok

components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(38,60,50,0.1); background: var(--bg-surface, #fffefa); color: var(--color-ink, #263c32); padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-badge { border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(38,60,50,0.1); padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--color-muted, #637067); }

components.name: Text & Money Input
components.description: Accessible 44px form input with top label and tabular numerals for Rupiah entry.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #263c32); } .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(38,60,50,0.25); background: transparent; color: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #28543e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Horizontally scrollable pill filters (<x-filter-chips>) for mobile lists.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(38,60,50,0.15); background: rgba(38,60,50,0.05); color: rgba(38,60,50,0.8); transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(38,60,50,0.1); } .ds-chip-active { border-color: transparent; background: var(--color-brand, #28543e); color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic due-date and alert status pill (<x-badge-status>).
components.html: TerlambatHari iniSegeraSelesai
components.css: .ds-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge-danger { background: rgba(173,63,69,0.15); color: #ad3f45; border: 1px solid rgba(173,63,69,0.2); } .ds-badge-warning { background: rgba(135,87,31,0.15); color: #87571f; border: 1px solid rgba(135,87,31,0.2); } .ds-badge-info { background: rgba(56,101,120,0.15); color: #386578; border: 1px solid rgba(56,101,120,0.2); } .ds-badge-done { background: rgba(40,84,62,0.15); color: #28543e; border: 1px solid rgba(40,84,62,0.2); }

components.name: Mobile Bottom Navigation
components.description: Fixed 5-slot mobile bottom bar with elevated center [+] FAB.
components.html: BerandaKalender
components.css: .ds-bnav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; min-height: 72px; padding: 6px 12px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(38,60,50,0.1); background: rgba(255,254,250,0.95); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bnav-item { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 48px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-muted, #637067); } .ds-bnav-active { font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-brand, #28543e); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-fab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; margin-top: -16px; border: none; border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--color-brand, #28543e); color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-fab:hover { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-fab-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

narrative.overview:
Family Hub is designed as a calm, organic, paper-and-ink workspace for couples managing daily home life together. Rather than feeling like an enterprise dashboard or a generic SaaS template, the interface pairs warm linen surfaces with deep forest-green anchors and classic bookish serif headings. Every screen is built mobile-first from `360px` upward so capturing an expense, checking off a chore, or reviewing a bill takes minimal taps with one thumb.

The aesthetic relies on tonal layering, generous corner radii, and clear semantic restraint. Generic SaaS blues and cool slates, heavy 3D drop shadows, and raw Unicode emojis as UI icons are explicitly rejected in favor of warm neutrals, subtle hairline borders, and inline Heroicons SVGs.
keyCharacteristics: Warm linen canvas (`#f6f4ee`) and paper-cream cards (`#fffefa`) in light mode; deep pine (`#151f1b`) and moss surface (`#1f2c25`) in dark mode
Forest Canopy (`#28543e`) and Forest Sage (`#bad6ae`) as disciplined primary action and active-state anchors
Local serif display headings paired with clean sans-serif UI copy and `tabular-nums` for all currency figures
Mobile-first `44px` touch targets, bottom navigation with a center `[+]` FAB, and responsive bottom sheets

rules.name: The Single Canopy Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve Forest Canopy (`#28543e` / `#bad6ae`) for primary actions, active navigation, and positive progress; never introduce competing brand hues (`indigo-*`, `emerald-600`, `blue-600`) for primary chrome.

rules.name: The Tabular Currency Rule
rules.body: Every Rupiah (`Rp`) amount rendered via `<x-money>` or `<x-input-money>` must use `tabular-nums` so columns of figures align cleanly across mobile cards and reports.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards and list rows stay flat at rest with hairline borders (`border-current/10`) and `shadow-xs`; reserve deeper shadows exclusively for floating FABs and modal dialogs.

dos: Do reuse Core Blade primitives (`<x-card>`, `<x-badge-status>`, `<x-empty-state>`, `<x-filter-chips>`, `<x-money>`, `<x-date>`, `<x-bottom-sheet>`, `<x-confirm>`) across every module.
Do enforce minimum `44px` (`min-h-11`) touch targets on interactive mobile buttons, links, and list checkboxes.
Do use Heroicons SVG (`<x-heroicon-o-*>` / `<x-heroicon-s-*>`) consistently for all UI iconography and keep all UI copy in Indonesian.
Do pair `prefers-reduced-motion` support with lightweight `transform`/`opacity` transitions (`150–200ms`).
donts: Don't introduce off-system palettes (`slate-*`, `stone-*`, `indigo-*`, `bg-white`, `emerald-600`) or Boxicons (`<i class='bx ...'>`) in application views.
Don't use raw Unicode emojis (`📋`, `🛒`, `⚠️`, `🛠️`) as UI icons.
Don't load external font or CSS CDNs, or add heavy 3D shadows and layout-shifting hover scales.
